introduce: Sit on a chair with your back straight. Slowly lift your left knee straight up, then slowly lower it down.
name: KNEE LIFT LEFT

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Please keep your back straight.
Please do this exercise slowly and do not use the impulsive force.
Please don't lean forward or backward during the exercise.
This exercise strengthens your hip flexors.

introduce:
Sit straight in the chair with your feet flat on the floor. 

Grab the left edge of your chair with your right hand. Then reach your left arm overhead, and bend your body to the right. 

Hold this position.
name: SIDE BEND REACH LEFT

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Breathe naturally.
You can feel your obliques stretched.
This exercise is good for your lower back.

introduce:

Grab the right edge of your chair with your left hand. Then reach your right arm overhead and bend your body to the left. 

Hold this position.
name: SIDE BEND REACH RIGHT

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.

introduce: Sit on a chair. Bend your arms with your fingers touching your shoulders.\n\nRotate your elbows clockwise in big circles several times, then rotate counterclockwise. Repeat this exercise.
name: SEATED BENT ARM CIRCLES

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Breathe regularly.
This exercise works your upper and inner chest muscles.
This exercise helps warm up your shoulders and activate your upper body.

introduce:
Sit on a chair. Bend your arms at a 90 degree angle to your sides. 

Keep your upper arms parallel to the floor and palms facing forward. 

Push your forearms together and press them against each other, then return and repeat.
name: SEATED BENT ARM CHEST FLY

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Breathe regularly.
Keep your back straight.
Feel the squeeze on your chest.
Press your forearms against each other as hard as you can.
Keep your arms at a 90 degree angle.
This exercise activates your upper back muscles and improves your posture.

introduce:
Sit on a chair. Put your left ankle on your right knee.

Hinge forward from the hips, using your left hand to push your knee down toward the ground. 

Hold it for a few seconds.
name: CHAIR GLUTE STRETCH LEFT

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Keep your back straight.
Please relax your hips.
Breathe regularly.
To make a deeper stretch, pull your crossed leg closer to your body.
This exercise stretches your hamstrings and glutes and can reduce your lower back pain.

introduce:
Sit on a chair with your legs hip-with apart and your feet flat on the floor. Interlock your fingers and turn your palms upwards. 

Inhale, lengthen your spine and stretch your arms toward the ceiling. Place your hands in line with the crown of your head.

Try to lengthen your spine with each inhalation. Gently move your shoulders down and back to enhance the stretch in your upper back.

Keep your neck neutral and your gaze in front of you. Hold this position for a few breaths.
name: CHAIR PALM TREE POSE

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Engage your core muscles.
Keep your back straight.
Breathe in deeply and breathe out completely.
This pose can wake up the muscles of your shoulders and back.
This pose helps increase the flexibility of your back, shoulders and arms.

introduce:
Sit on a chair with your legs hip-with apart and your feet flat on the floor.

Take a deep breath and as you exhale, slowly curl your chin to your chest, draw your lower belly in and round your back. 

Fold your body and press your entire palms on the floor. With every exhalation, move your chest and shoulders away from your thighs. Hold this position for a few breaths.
name: CHAIR CHILD'S POSE

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Engage your core muscles.
Breathe in deeply and breathe out completely.
This pose helps to release tightness in your neck, shoulders, lower back, and hips.

introduce:
Prepare a chair without armrests where your feet can touch the floor when sitting. 

Sit on the edge of the chair. Inhale, open your left leg out towards the left. Make sure your knee is aligned with your ankle, pointing in the same direction as your toes and forming a 90-degree angle.

Exhale, extend your right leg to the right with your toes facing forward. Raise your arms to your sides at shoulder height with your palms down.

Draw your belly in, tuck your tailbone down, and lift your chest. Take your gaze to your left hand. Hold this position.
name: CHAIR WARRIOR II LEFT

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Don't let your bent knee go over your toes.
Breathe in deeply and breathe out completely.
Draw your shoulders away from your ears and keep them relaxed.
This exercise strengthens your lower body and shoulders.
